visual.general_description: Photograph of a monitor displaying a grayscale two-dimensional ultrasound sector image on the left and a rendered three-dimensional fetal profile on the right, with two black arrows on the rendered image.
visual.detailed_description: The picture is an oblique photograph of a dark display; the screen edges and a dark bezel are visible at the right. On the left is a grayscale ultrasound sector-shaped image with a thin green line and a thin white-outlined box across it; its internal structures are blurred and cannot be named from pixels. A small cream-colored arrow lies between the two displays. On the right is a cream-colored shaded three-dimensional surface rendering with blue background at its edges, showing a side view of a face-like profile with several adjacent rounded surfaces to its left. Two black arrows face each other and point toward the mid-facial region of the profile from opposite sides. No printed text, panel letters, measurement values, scale, patient identifiers or dates are legible.
